wildflower_meadow.plant_zh: 茂密高草、黄色野花与少量红色罂粟状花朵
wildflower_meadow.plant_en: dense tall grass, yellow wildflowers and a few vivid red poppy-like flowers
wildflower_meadow.entry_zh: 相机贴地并深入草丛内部，虫眼视角垂直向上
wildflower_meadow.entry_en: camera at ground level, hidden inside the grass, looking vertically upward from an insect-eye perspective
wildflower_meadow.enclosure_zh: 草叶与细长花茎从四周包围镜头，形成不规则绿色植物隧道
wildflower_meadow.enclosure_en: grass blades and slender stems surround the lens and form an irregular green botanical tunnel
wildflower_meadow.window_en: a small clear blue-sky opening in the center
wildflower_meadow.hook_zh: 靠近天空窗口的一朵鲜红小花
wildflower_meadow.hook_en: one vivid red flower close to the sky opening

secret_flower_tunnel.plant_zh: 宽大深绿色叶片、密集枝条与洋红色花朵
secret_flower_tunnel.plant_en: broad deep-green leaves, dense stems and magenta flowers
secret_flower_tunnel.entry_zh: 镜头藏进花株根部深处，从幽暗植物内部向上仰望
secret_flower_tunnel.entry_en: camera hidden deep near the base of flowering plants, looking upward from inside the dark foliage
secret_flower_tunnel.enclosure_zh: 大片叶片近距离遮挡四周，形成幽暗狭长的天然植物洞穴
secret_flower_tunnel.enclosure_en: large nearby leaves occlude the frame edges and create a dark narrow botanical cave
secret_flower_tunnel.window_zh: 隧道尽头很小的明亮蓝天窗口
secret_flower_tunnel.window_en: a tiny bright blue-sky window at the end of the tunnel
secret_flower_tunnel.hook_en: one deep-magenta flower in the middle distance
secret_flower_tunnel.light_zh: 中央天空进入的自然光，外围明显更暗
secret_flower_tunnel.light_en: natural skylight entering from the center with darker edges

bamboo_forest.plant_zh: 细长青竹、竹叶与自然落叶
bamboo_forest.plant_en: slender green bamboo, bamboo leaves and natural fallen leaves
bamboo_forest.entry_zh: 相机位于竹林地面，夹在竹竿之间向上及远处观看
bamboo_forest.entry_en: camera on the bamboo-forest floor, looking upward and forward between bamboo culms
bamboo_forest.enclosure_zh: 竹竿与竹叶在四周形成高耸的天然纵向框架
bamboo_forest.enclosure_en: bamboo culms and leaves form a tall natural vertical enclosure
bamboo_forest.window_zh: 竹林深处露出的一小片远山与天空
bamboo_forest.window_en: a small glimpse of distant mountain and sky through the bamboo
bamboo_forest.light_en: soft natural morning skylight from above and to the side

lotus_pond.plant_zh: 巨大翠绿荷叶、细长荷梗与少量荷花
lotus_pond.plant_en: large emerald lotus leaves, slender stems and a few lotus blossoms
lotus_pond.entry_zh: 相机几乎贴着水面并藏在荷叶下方，从叶片之间向外观看
lotus_pond.entry_en: camera almost touching the water, hidden beneath lotus leaves and looking outward through them
lotus_pond.enclosure_zh: 荷叶从上方与两侧形成层层叠叠的天然伞盖
lotus_pond.enclosure_en: overlapping lotus leaves form a natural canopy from above and both sides
lotus_pond.window_zh: 荷叶之间一小片反射天空的清澈水面
lotus_pond.window_en: a small patch of clear water reflecting the sky between the leaves
lotus_pond.hook_zh: 远处唯一一朵纯白荷花
lotus_pond.hook_en: a single pure-white lotus blossom in the distance
lotus_pond.light_en: soft high natural light after rain

reed_marsh.plant_zh: 高密度芦苇、细长叶片与浅金色芦花
reed_marsh.plant_en: dense reeds, slender blades and pale-gold reed plumes
reed_marsh.entry_zh: 镜头位于芦苇根部低处，从密集茎秆之间穿行般望向远方
reed_marsh.entry_en: camera low among reed roots, looking forward as if moving through dense stems
reed_marsh.enclosure_zh: 芦苇从两侧与上方交错包围，构成长而窄的自然通道
reed_marsh.enclosure_en: reeds cross from both sides and above to form a long narrow natural corridor
reed_marsh.window_zh: 通道尽头的一小片天空
reed_marsh.window_en: a small piece of sky at the end of the corridor
reed_marsh.light_zh: 傍晚偏暖的低角度自然光

winter_branches.plant_zh: 覆雪细枝、少量深色树皮与残留红果
winter_branches.plant_en: snow-covered fine branches, dark bark and a few remaining red berries
winter_branches.entry_zh: 镜头位于低矮雪枝下方，穿过枝条向上看
winter_branches.entry_en: camera beneath low snow-covered branches, looking upward through them
winter_branches.enclosure_zh: 积雪枝条从四周形成洁白而不规则的天然框景
winter_branches.enclosure_en: snow-covered branches create a white irregular natural enclosure
winter_branches.window_zh: 枝条之间一小块清冷淡蓝天空
winter_branches.window_en: a small pale-blue winter-sky opening between branches
winter_branches.light_zh: 正午清澈高位冬日天光

autumn_maple.plant_zh: 橙红枫叶、深色细枝与少量未变色叶片
autumn_maple.plant_en: orange-red maple leaves, dark fine branches and a few remaining green leaves
autumn_maple.entry_zh: 镜头位于低矮枫树冠下方，向上穿过叶层
autumn_maple.entry_en: camera beneath a low maple canopy, looking upward through layered leaves
autumn_maple.enclosure_zh: 秋叶在四周构成暖色天然穹顶
autumn_maple.enclosure_en: autumn leaves form a warm natural dome around the frame
autumn_maple.window_zh: 叶隙中一块小而干净的青蓝天空
autumn_maple.window_en: a small clean cyan-blue sky opening between leaves
autumn_maple.hook_zh: 一片正缓慢坠落的叶子
autumn_maple.hook_en: one leaf caught in a gentle fall

mossy_stream.plant_zh: 湿润苔藓、蕨类、小型阔叶植物与天然石块
mossy_stream.plant_en: wet moss, ferns, small broadleaf plants and natural stones
mossy_stream.entry_zh: 镜头贴近长满苔藓的地面，从石块与蕨叶之间向溪流深处观看
mossy_stream.entry_en: camera close to the mossy ground, looking toward the stream through rocks and fern leaves
mossy_stream.enclosure_zh: 苔藓石块与蕨叶形成低矮、潮湿的绿色峡谷
mossy_stream.enclosure_en: mossy rocks and fern leaves form a low moist green ravine
mossy_stream.window_zh: 深处一小段反光的清澈溪水
mossy_stream.window_en: a small reflective patch of clear stream water in the distance
mossy_stream.hook_en: one bright new green leaf beside the stream
mossy_stream.light_zh: 森林顶部过滤后的柔和自然光
mossy_stream.light_en: soft natural light filtered through the forest canopy

wheat_field.plant_en: mature wheat heads and slender stalks
wheat_field.entry_zh: 镜头贴近土面深入麦秆之间，沿麦穗形成的缝隙向上望
wheat_field.entry_en: camera close to soil, entering between wheat stalks and looking upward through their gaps
wheat_field.enclosure_zh: 麦秆和麦穗从四周压近镜头，形成金色狭长通道
wheat_field.enclosure_en: wheat stalks and heads press around the lens to form a narrow golden corridor
wheat_field.window_zh: 麦穗之间一小块明亮天空
wheat_field.window_en: a small bright sky opening between wheat heads
wheat_field.hook_zh: 一根被光照亮的弯曲麦穗
wheat_field.hook_en: one curved wheat head caught by light

rice_field.plant_zh: 青绿稻叶与沉甸甸稻穗
rice_field.plant_en: green rice blades and heavy rice panicles
rice_field.entry_zh: 相机贴近田埂低处，从稻株根部之间向田野深处探入
rice_field.entry_en: camera low beside the paddy ridge, probing forward between rice plants
rice_field.enclosure_zh: 稻叶交错包围镜头并形成柔软绿色通道
rice_field.enclosure_en: crossing rice blades surround the lens and create a soft green corridor
rice_field.window_zh: 稻株之间一小段反光水面与天空
rice_field.window_en: a small reflective patch of paddy water and sky

sunflower_field.plant_zh: 高大向日葵茎叶与黄色花盘
sunflower_field.plant_en: tall sunflower stems, leaves and yellow flower heads
sunflower_field.entry_zh: 镜头位于向日葵根部之间，贴地向上穿过高大植株
sunflower_field.entry_en: camera between sunflower roots, looking upward through tall plants
sunflower_field.enclosure_zh: 巨大叶片和茎秆从四周构成高耸植物围墙
sunflower_field.enclosure_en: large leaves and stems form a towering botanical enclosure
sunflower_field.window_zh: 花盘之间的一小片蓝天
sunflower_field.window_en: a small blue-sky opening between flower heads
sunflower_field.hook_zh: 一朵略微低头的向日葵

cherry_blossom.plant_zh: 樱花枝、浅粉花簇与嫩叶
cherry_blossom.plant_en: cherry branches, pale-pink blossom clusters and young leaves
cherry_blossom.entry_zh: 镜头位于低垂樱枝下，从枝花层之间向上寻找天空
cherry_blossom.entry_en: camera beneath low cherry branches, looking upward through layered blossoms
cherry_blossom.enclosure_zh: 花枝从四周自然交叠形成轻盈花冠
cherry_blossom.enclosure_en: blossoming branches overlap around the frame to form a light floral canopy
cherry_blossom.window_zh: 花枝之间一小块淡蓝天空
cherry_blossom.window_en: a small pale-blue sky opening between blossoms
cherry_blossom.hook_en: one petal just detached from a branch

wisteria.plant_zh: 垂落紫藤花序、藤蔓与绿叶
wisteria.plant_en: hanging wisteria racemes, vines and green leaves
wisteria.entry_zh: 镜头进入垂落花序内部，从藤蔓之间向上及远处观看
wisteria.entry_en: camera enters among hanging racemes, looking upward and forward through vines
wisteria.enclosure_zh: 紫藤花序与藤叶从四周垂落包围，形成天然帘幕
wisteria.enclosure_en: wisteria flowers and leaves hang around the lens as a natural curtain
wisteria.window_zh: 藤蔓尽头的一小片天空
wisteria.window_en: a small sky opening beyond the vines
wisteria.hook_en: one wisteria raceme caught by light

fern_forest.plant_zh: 大型蕨叶、湿润腐殖土与幼嫩卷叶
fern_forest.plant_en: large fern fronds, moist humus and young curled shoots
fern_forest.entry_zh: 相机贴近森林地表，从蕨叶下方穿行般向深处观看
fern_forest.entry_en: camera close to forest floor, moving visually beneath fern fronds
fern_forest.enclosure_zh: 巨大蕨叶从两侧和上方包围成低矮绿色穹顶
fern_forest.enclosure_en: large fern fronds enclose the lens from sides and above as a low green dome
fern_forest.window_zh: 蕨叶深处一小束明亮森林光
fern_forest.window_en: a small bright forest-light opening beyond the ferns

pine_forest.plant_zh: 松针、粗糙树干与林下灌木
pine_forest.plant_en: pine needles, rough trunks and understory shrubs
pine_forest.entry_zh: 镜头位于松针覆盖的地面，从树干之间低角度望向林外
pine_forest.entry_en: camera on pine-needle-covered ground, looking low between trunks toward the forest edge
pine_forest.enclosure_zh: 松干与低垂枝条形成深色纵向包围
pine_forest.enclosure_en: pine trunks and low branches create a dark vertical enclosure
pine_forest.window_zh: 林木尽头一小片明亮天空
pine_forest.window_en: a small bright sky opening beyond the trees
pine_forest.hook_en: one pine cone caught by light

birch_grove.plant_zh: 白色树干、细枝与轻薄叶片
birch_grove.plant_en: white birch trunks, fine branches and light leaves
birch_grove.entry_zh: 镜头从林地低处进入白桦树干之间，沿纵向缝隙望向远处
birch_grove.entry_en: camera enters low between birch trunks, looking through a vertical gap
birch_grove.enclosure_zh: 白桦树干从两侧构成不规则明暗框架
birch_grove.enclosure_en: birch trunks form an irregular light-dark frame on both sides
birch_grove.window_zh: 树干之间一小片远处天空
birch_grove.window_en: a small distant sky opening between trunks
birch_grove.dominant_en: white, pale green and restrained dark markings

bamboo_after_rain.plant_en: wet green bamboo, leaves and droplets
bamboo_after_rain.entry_zh: 相机贴近湿润竹林地面，从滴水竹叶之间向上探入
bamboo_after_rain.entry_en: camera close to the wet bamboo floor, probing upward through dripping leaves
bamboo_after_rain.enclosure_zh: 湿竹叶贴近镜头形成层层遮挡
bamboo_after_rain.enclosure_en: wet bamboo leaves create layered close occlusion
bamboo_after_rain.window_zh: 叶隙之间一小块雨后亮天空
bamboo_after_rain.window_en: a small bright post-rain sky opening between leaves
bamboo_after_rain.hook_zh: 叶尖即将坠落的一滴水
bamboo_after_rain.hook_en: one droplet about to fall from a leaf tip

banana_grove.plant_zh: 巨大芭蕉叶、粗壮叶柄与自然裂口
banana_grove.plant_en: huge banana leaves, thick petioles and natural leaf tears
banana_grove.entry_zh: 镜头藏在巨大芭蕉叶下方，从叶柄之间垂直向上
banana_grove.entry_en: camera hidden beneath huge banana leaves, looking vertically upward between petioles
banana_grove.enclosure_zh: 宽大叶片像天然屋顶一样从四周包围
banana_grove.enclosure_en: broad leaves surround the lens like a natural roof
banana_grove.window_zh: 叶片裂隙间一小块高亮天空
banana_grove.window_en: a small bright sky opening through torn leaves
banana_grove.hook_zh: 一处透光的嫩绿色叶缘
banana_grove.dominant_en: deep green and translucent young green

tea_garden.plant_zh: 密集茶树嫩叶与弯曲枝条
tea_garden.plant_en: dense tea shoots and curved branches
tea_garden.entry_zh: 镜头降低到茶树冠层内部，从嫩叶之间向坡地远处看
tea_garden.entry_en: camera lowered inside the tea canopy, looking through shoots toward the distant slope
tea_garden.enclosure_zh: 茶叶从四周近距离形成细密绿色包围
tea_garden.enclosure_en: tea leaves create a dense close green enclosure
tea_garden.window_zh: 茶树行列尽头的一小片远山
tea_garden.window_en: a small distant mountain opening beyond tea rows

lavender_field.plant_zh: 细长灰绿叶与紫色花穗
lavender_field.plant_en: slender gray-green leaves and violet flower spikes
lavender_field.entry_zh: 镜头贴近土面进入花穗根部，从紫色植物通道向外看
lavender_field.entry_en: camera close to soil, entering between lavender stems and looking outward
lavender_field.enclosure_zh: 花穗从两侧倾入构成低矮紫绿色隧道
lavender_field.enclosure_en: flower spikes lean inward from both sides to create a low violet-green tunnel
lavender_field.window_zh: 花穗尽头一小块暖色天空
lavender_field.window_en: a small warm-sky opening beyond the flower spikes
lavender_field.hook_zh: 一只停在远处花穗上的小蝴蝶
lavender_field.hook_en: one tiny butterfly resting on a distant flower spike

hydrangea_garden.plant_zh: 大型绣球花球、宽叶与枝条
hydrangea_garden.plant_en: large hydrangea clusters, broad leaves and stems
hydrangea_garden.entry_zh: 镜头进入绣球花株下层，从巨大花球之间向上寻找出口
hydrangea_garden.entry_en: camera enters the lower hydrangea layer, looking upward between large flower clusters
hydrangea_garden.enclosure_zh: 花球和宽叶从四周形成厚重柔软包围
hydrangea_garden.enclosure_en: flower clusters and broad leaves create a dense soft enclosure
hydrangea_garden.window_zh: 花球之间一小块明亮天空
hydrangea_garden.window_en: a small bright sky opening between clusters
hydrangea_garden.hook_zh: 一朵颜色更浅的绣球花球
hydrangea_garden.dominant_en: blue-violet or pink-violet with deep green

camellia_thicket.plant_zh: 深绿蜡质叶片与红色山茶花
camellia_thicket.plant_en: deep glossy leaves and red camellia blossoms
camellia_thicket.entry_zh: 镜头藏入山茶枝叶深处，从叶片夹缝向外仰望
camellia_thicket.entry_en: camera hidden deep inside camellia foliage, looking outward and upward through leaf gaps
camellia_thicket.enclosure_zh: 深色厚叶从四周压近形成幽暗植物洞穴
camellia_thicket.enclosure_en: dark thick leaves press around the frame to create a botanical cave
camellia_thicket.window_zh: 枝叶尽头一小块冷色天空
camellia_thicket.window_en: a small cool-sky opening beyond the foliage
camellia_thicket.dominant_en: deep green with a single red accent

coastal_grass.plant_zh: 海风中的长草、低矮野花与砂质地表
coastal_grass.plant_en: windblown long grass, low wildflowers and sandy ground
coastal_grass.entry_zh: 镜头贴近海岸草坡地面，从被风压弯的草叶之间向海面方向看
coastal_grass.entry_en: camera close to a coastal slope, looking toward the sea through wind-bent grass
coastal_grass.enclosure_zh: 长草从两侧倾斜包围形成随风变化的天然通道
coastal_grass.enclosure_en: long grasses lean inward from both sides to form a wind-shaped corridor
coastal_grass.window_zh: 草叶尽头一小块海天交界
coastal_grass.window_en: a small sea-and-sky opening beyond the grass
coastal_grass.hook_zh: 一朵贴地开放的小野花

alpine_meadow.plant_en: short grass, alpine flowers and small stones
alpine_meadow.entry_zh: 镜头贴近高山地表，从矮花与碎石之间向远山方向探入
alpine_meadow.entry_en: camera close to alpine ground, probing between low flowers and stones toward distant mountains
alpine_meadow.enclosure_zh: 矮草与石块在近景形成低矮包围
alpine_meadow.enclosure_en: short grass and stones create a low foreground enclosure
alpine_meadow.window_zh: 草甸尽头一小块雪山或天空
alpine_meadow.window_en: a small snow-mountain or sky opening beyond the meadow
alpine_meadow.hook_zh: 一朵颜色鲜明的高山小花
